prompt: Create ONE original raster PNG technical educational diagram for a Korean IT blog. White opaque background, navy readable sans-serif text, flat blue/teal boxes, generous whitespace. Four clearly separated return rows branching CPU: 1 I/O request→I/O queue→I/O completion→Ready queue. 2 Time slice expired→Ready queue. 3 Fork a child (parent waits)→Child executes / completes→Ready queue. 4 Wait for an interrupt→Interrupt occurs→Ready queue.
